description: Every name the allele behind an HLA name has had, release by release since IPD-IMGT/HLA 1.05.0: its HLA ID, current name, the first and last release that used this name, the full timeline of names, and the deletion note if the name was retired. `as_of` adds what it was called in that release. Use it to answer when a name appeared, changed or disappeared. An allele string only, no patient identifiers.

as_of.description: An IPD-IMGT/HLA release, like "3.40.0" (1.05.0 to the current one).

name.description: An allele name as written in any release, like "A*0101".

name: allele_history
